'''John Chalgren''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2001 Brooklyn Center tournament]] on 24 November 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|no R3 WYS]], according to Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3127">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-30-outpost-deadbody-style-11-24-01d3127/ outpost-deadbody-style-11-24-01], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 30 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-30-outpost-deadbody-style-11-24-01d3127/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
